Intro.title: Spaces that do more than work: they convey feeling and tell stories.
Intro.body1: Our name comes from Latin, where “et” means “and”. It stands for the union of the many different actors in architecture.

cafe.title: Ochre café
cafe.summary: Ochre plaster, timber joinery and a pale-green steel frame around a compact coffee counter.
cafe.description: A compact café where ochre-toned walls and a warm timber counter meet a pale-green steel frame with translucent glass. Red pendant lamps hang over the counter, and an arched window of red tile glows beside the stair. A narrow washroom repeats the palette with an oval mirror and a pale-green door.

desierto.title: Desert restaurant
desierto.summary: Warm plaster, geometric relief walls and a planter of cacti beneath a sculpted textile ceiling.
desierto.description: A dining room built around desert warmth: ochre plaster walls, backlit geometric relief panels and long planters of cacti. One view shows sculpted textile forms drifting beneath a skylight; another shows a green-painted passage with timber doors and woven panels.

billar.title: Billiards lounge
billar.summary: Deep green panelling, a coffered timber ceiling and cognac leather seating.
billar.description: A lounge in deep green: panelled walls with a scalloped cornice, a coffered timber ceiling and arched windows with sheer curtains. Billiard tables sit beside cognac leather sofas, brass side tables and a tall timber-framed mirror. The second view looks into a corner with a palm and wall sconces.

bano.title: Green-tile bathroom
bano.summary: Vertical green tile, a glass-block partition and warm timber with copper-toned fittings.
bano.description: A bathroom wrapped in glossy green tile laid in vertical stacks. A glass-block partition lets light reach the shower, while a timber ceiling, a floating vanity and illuminated shelves keep the room warm. A patterned tile floor and a framed artwork complete the composition.

azotea.title: Apartment with roof terrace
azotea.summary: A roof terrace under a timber pergola, with warm timber furniture and generous planting.
azotea.description: A residence in photographs. A slatted timber pergola throws patterned shade across the roof terrace, where a built-in timber sofa sits among planters. Inside, a bedroom with a timber headboard and wardrobes, and living areas with grey sofas, track lighting and framed prints.

cine.title: Cinema bar
cine.summary: Golden plaster, timber booths and framed Mexican cinema posters.
cine.description: A narrow bar lit like a film set: warm plaster walls with red wall lights, mirrored panels and timber booths upholstered in red. Framed Mexican cinema posters line the walls, and a timber counter with pale-green steel stools runs the length of the room.

oficina.title: Two-level studio
oficina.summary: A mezzanine office with a translucent stair, green steel framing and open shelving.
oficina.description: A workspace organised on two levels. A translucent panel framed in green steel wraps the stair, open shelving in blue-painted steel divides the floor, and timber platforms hold the desks. Upstairs, a mezzanine with a glass-and-steel balustrade overlooks a lounge with bean bags and plants.

terraza.title: Planted street canopy
terraza.summary: A timber-and-steel pergola with a translucent roof above black planters at the street edge.
terraza.description: A street-front canopy made of timber beams, slim black steel posts and a translucent roof. Black steel planters filled with shrubs, climbers and small trees form a green screen between the pavement and the interior behind it.

sala.title: Blue-ceiling lounge
sala.summary: A navy steel ceiling grid, terracotta seating and a timber window seat.
sala.description: A living space under a dark-blue steel grid ceiling. Terracotta sofas and a pouf sit on a pale oval rug, with blue shelving and cabinetry along one wall, a timber window bench with a teal cushion, and a deep-red column beside a glazed steel partition.

cocina.title: Kitchen under a planted skylight
cocina.summary: A timber-and-stone island beneath a skylight of timber beams draped with plants.
cocina.description: An open kitchen organised around a long timber island with a stone-topped cooking counter. Above it, timber beams frame a skylight draped in climbing plants, and a pendant lamp hangs over the dining end. Warm timber cabinetry and pale surfaces keep the space calm.

vestidor.title: Timber dressing room
vestidor.summary: Floor-to-ceiling timber joinery, a herringbone floor and a window seat facing a garden.
vestidor.description: A room clad in vertical-grain timber joinery from floor to ceiling, with concealed lighting along the ceiling edge. A herringbone timber floor leads to a central timber island and a window seat framed by sheer curtains and slatted blinds, looking onto greenery.

fachada.title: House with a pink façade
fachada.summary: A soft-pink façade with black steel windows and a gate clad in richly grained timber planks.
fachada.description: A street façade in soft pink with large black steel-framed windows across two storeys. At street level, a steel-framed gate clad in vertical timber planks with strong grain and colour variation anchors the composition.

Studio.title: The Studio
Studio.body1: Our name comes from Latin, where “et” means “and”. It stands for the union of the many different actors in architecture.
Studio.body2: With this approach, we create spaces that do more than work: they convey feeling and tell stories.
Studio.body3: Each project brings people into the act of inhabiting, using materials, textures, lighting and furniture to build atmospheres that reflect who they are and elevate their way of life. Discover how we can turn your vision into a unique aesthetic and emotional experience.
